ask: can u make a poll for this and track who hasnt voted
sentence: A two-question group poll (going yes/maybe/no, and stay over or day trip) that shows vote counts, lists who has not answered yet, and can be closed and reopened by whoever closed it.
use_when: Asking a group if they are coming to an event and who is staying overnight
Checking who still has not replied before a deadline
Getting a quick headcount for a trip or get-together
Closing responses once the deadline passes
dont_use_when: Picking a date or time from several options, which needs a scheduling poll
Splitting costs or tracking who owes money
Collecting free-text answers or open suggestions
